blocks.content: 1. British Constitutional Acts: Regulating Act 1773 (Governor-General of Bengal) | Pitt's India Act 1784 (Board of Control) | Charter Act 1833 (Gov-Gen of India, end EIC monopoly) | Govt of India Act 1919 (Dyarchy in States) | 1935 Act (Provincial Autonomy).

2. Landmark INC Sessions: 1885 Bombay (W.C. Bonnerjee) | 1906 Calcutta (Dadabhai Naoroji - Swaraj) | 1907 Surat Split (Rashbehari Ghosh) | 1916 Lucknow Reunion (A.C. Majumdar) | 1929 Lahore (Nehru - Purna Swaraj) | 1931 Karachi (Sardar Patel - Fundamental Rights).

3. Agrarian & Tribal Uprisings: Santhal Rebellion 1855 (Sidhu & Kanhu) | Munda Ulgulan 1899 (Birsa Munda) | Indigo Revolt 1859 (Digambar & Biswas) | Pabna 1873 | Bardoli Satyagraha 1928 (Sardar Patel).

4. Gandhian Movements Chronology: Champaran 1917 $ightarrow$ Kheda 1918 $ightarrow$ Ahmedabad Mill 1918 $ightarrow$ Rowlatt 1919 $ightarrow$ Non-Cooperation 1920 $ightarrow$ Civil Disobedience 1930 $ightarrow$ Quit India 1942.

blocks.text:
⚡ 1. British Charter & Government of India Acts Flash Table
| Act | Key Constitutional Innovation | Major Historical Trap |
|---|---|---|
| **Regulating Act 1773** | Created Supreme Court at Calcutta; Gov-Gen of Bengal | Warren Hastings was 1st Gov-Gen of **Bengal** (NOT India!) |
| **Charter Act 1813** | Ended EIC trade monopoly EXCEPT in **Tea and China trade** | Allowed Christian missionaries to enter India legally |
| **Charter Act 1833** | **Total end of EIC commercial trade monopoly**; Gov-Gen of India | Lord William Bentinck became 1st Governor-General of **India** |
| **Govt of India Act 1858** | Transfer of power to British Crown; Secretary of State | Lord Canning became 1st **Viceroy of India** |
| **Indian Councils Act 1909** | **Morley-Minto Reforms:** Separate electorates for Muslims | Introduced communal representation into Indian legislature |
| **Govt of India Act 1919** | **Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms:** Dyarchy in **Provinces** | Divided provincial subjects into Transferred & Reserved |
| **Govt of India Act 1935** | **Provincial Autonomy**; proposed All-India Federation | Dyarchy shifted from Provinces to **Center** |

📖 2. High-Yield INC Sessions & Resolutions Matrix
- **1917 Calcutta Session:** **Annie Besant** became the 1st Woman President of INC.
- **1924 Belgaum Session:** **Mahatma Gandhi** presided over his ONLY INC session!
- **1925 Kanpur Session:** **Sarojini Naidu** became the 1st **Indian** Woman President of INC.
- **1929 Lahore Session:** Jawaharlal Nehru presided; passed **Purna Swaraj** (Complete Independence) resolution; unfurled tricolor on Ravi bank (Jan 26 declared Independence Day).
- **1931 Karachi Session:** Vallabhbhai Patel presided; adopted resolutions on **Fundamental Rights** and **National Economic Programme** (drafted by Nehru).

⚖3. Common Prelims & Mains Traps
- ⚠️ **Exam Trap 1:** 1st Woman INC President was **Annie Besant** (1917), but 1st **INDIAN** Woman INC President was **Sarojini Naidu** (1925)!
- ⚠️ **Exam Trap 2:** Dyarchy was introduced in **PROVINCES** by the 1919 Act, and abolished in provinces (shifted to Center) by the **1935 Act**.

blocks.content:
#### Tier 1 — Recall MCQ
**Q:** At which historic Indian National Congress session presided over by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel were resolutions on 'Fundamental Rights' and the 'National Economic Programme' officially adopted?  
(A) 1929 Lahore Session  
(B) 1931 Karachi Session  
(C) 1920 Nagpur Session  
(D) 1936 Lucknow Session  
**Answer: — 1931 Karachi Session adopted Fundamental Rights resolutions.

#### Tier 2 — Applied Scenario
**Scenario:** Arrange the following Gandhian struggles in exact chronological order: (1) Kheda Satyagraha, (2) Champaran Satyagraha, (3) Ahmedabad Mill Strike, (4) Rowlatt Satyagraha.  
**Resolution:** Exact sequence: Champaran (April 1917) $ightarrow$ Ahmedabad Mill (Feb 1918) $ightarrow$ Kheda (March 1918) $ightarrow$ Rowlatt (April 1919). Order: **(2) $ightarrow$ (3) $ightarrow$ (1) $ightarrow$ (4)**.

#### Tier 3 — Mains Descriptive Prompt
*'Compare the structural changes introduced by the Government of India Act 1919 and the Government of India Act 1935. How did dyarchy shift between provinces and the center?'*

🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Gandhian Movement Chronology & Triggers: (1) Champaran 1917 (Tinkathia indigo system) ➔ Ahmedabad Mill 1918 (1st Hunger Strike) ➔ Kheda 1918 (1st Non-Cooperation); (2) Non-Cooperation Movement 1920 (called off after Chauri Chaura on 4 Feb 1922); (3) Civil Disobedience Movement 1930 (Dandi March 12 Mar–6 Apr 1930); (4) Quit India Movement (8 Aug 1942, Gowalia Tank, "Do or Die").
